script:
cp -r "$REPO" "$F/guard"
cp -r "$REPO" "$F/guard-sibling"
CID2=$(control-agent-server conversation start --workspace "$F/guard" --tools none --no-autotitle --print-id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/changes" --query path="$F/guard" --expect 200 --check . len-eq 2 \
  --check 0.path eq README.md --check 1.path eq notes.txt --save F15.scoped-guard/workspace
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/diff" --query path="$F/guard/README.md" --expect 200 \
  --check modified eq "$(cat "$F/guard/README.md")"
ln -s "$REPO" "$F/guard/qa-escape"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/changes" --query path="$REPO" --expect 422 \
  --check detail eq 'path must be inside the conversation workspace' --save F15.scoped-guard/other-dir
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/changes" --query path="$F/guard-sibling" --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/changes" --query path="$F/guard/../outer" --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/changes" --query path="$F/guard/qa-escape" --expect 422 \
  --check detail eq 'path must be inside the conversation workspace' --save F15.scoped-guard/symlink
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/diff" --query path="$F/guard/qa-escape/README.md" --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/diff" --query path=README.md --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/changes" --query path="$F/guard" --query path="$REPO" --expect 422 \
  --check detail eq 'path must be inside the conversation workspace' --save F15.scoped-guard/duplicate-path
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/commits" --query path="$REPO" --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID2/git/commits/$C2/changes" --query path="$REPO" --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET /api/git/changes --query path="$F/guard/qa-escape" --expect 200 --check . len-eq 2
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000/git/changes --query path="$REPO" \
  --expect 404 --check detail contains 'Conversation not found' --save F15.scoped-guard/unknown-conversation
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/git/changes --query path="$REPO" --expect 422
control-agent-server api GET /openapi.json --auth none --expect 200 --quiet \
  --check 'paths./api/git/repositories/search' exists \
  --check 'paths.<redacted:session-cookie>/{runtime_conversation_id}/git/changes' exists \
  --check 'paths.<redacted:session-cookie>/{runtime_conversation_id}/git/repositories/search' missing
